why_this_file_exists: The technical plan's Step 4 named three outcomes -- LEAK_SMALL_FILTER_OVERPRICED, LEAK_LARGE_FILTER_LOAD_BEARING, GATE_UNSATISFIABLE_ON_THIS_COMPARTMENT -- and ALL THREE presuppose that set C refuses the admissibility gate. Step 2 measured the null half of that gate on set C at 1.3571 nats against uniform 1.3863, i.e. CLEARING it, so the presupposition is false for at least one half and the outcome set is no longer exhaustive. Re-deriving the outcomes AFTER seeing the model numbers would be bar-shopping, so they are re-derived now, before the scoring run.
authority: Deviation from the saved plan's Step 4, taken on the executing session's judgement and recorded rather than silently applied. The plan's three outcome NAMES are preserved where they still apply; what changes is that they are conditioned on a measured gate state instead of an assumed one, and an explicit unresolved branch is added.

GEOMETRY_FIXED_NOW.basis: the scorer's OWN defaults (--n-windows 120 --positions 30), i.e. the geometry the committed run could have afforded but did not use. 3600 predictions against the committed run's 48 is a 75x increase.
GEOMETRY_FIXED_NOW.n_is_FIXED_BEFORE_THE_RUN: and may not be enlarged after seeing a result. Enlarging n until a contrast resolves is the defect this clause exists to prevent.
GEOMETRY_FIXED_NOW.window_selection_rule: sort the DISTINCT uppercased sequences of the set, then draw a seeded random sample with random.Random(0). NOT the first n of the sorted order: a lexicographic prefix is a biased sample of DNA (it over-selects A-rich windows), and NOT `of[:n]` either, which is MG1655 coordinate order. The reproduction path keeps `of[:n]` unchanged so the committed pin still holds.
GEOMETRY_FIXED_NOW.same_geometry_and_seed_for_every_set: so a difference between sets cannot be a difference in how they were sampled.

C_orthology_free.role: decides whether the committed refusal stands at power

A_sequence_withheld.role: the designed withhold, the plan's primary comparison set

why_the_contrast_is_A_minus_C_vs_A_inter: A and C overlap in 519 windows, so a 120-window sample of A is roughly 15% set C and the two arms would not be disjoint -- the contrast would be diluted toward zero by construction. A-minus-C against A-intersect-C is disjoint, both arms are withheld from the corpus, and both come from one builder, so the only systematic difference between them is whether the gene has a draft counterpart. That is the leak, isolated.

QUESTION_1_DOES_THE_COMMITTED_REFUSAL_ST.statistic: the admissibility gate state on set C at the fixed geometry, read BEFORE any delta

branches.ADMISSIBLE: both halves clear uniform at power. The committed EVAL_SET_UNINFORMATIVE_BELOW_UNIFORM was a 48-prediction artifact in BOTH halves, and the recorded explanation (accessory-gene out-of-distribution failure) is false as stated.
branches.REFUSED_MODEL_BELOW_UNIFORM: the set is demonstrably predictable and the MODEL is sub-uniform on it. The refusal stands but its MEANING changes: this is a model negative, not an uninformative eval set, and the runner's recorded 'no eval-side shortcut can be representative' sentence does not explain it.
branches.REFUSED_NULL_BELOW_UNIFORM: CONTRADICTS Step 2's all-position measurement of 1.3571 on the same set with the same null. Do not interpret -- investigate the instrument first, because two measurements of one quantity disagree.
branches.REFUSED_BOTH_BELOW_UNIFORM: same contradiction as above, plus a model failure. Investigate the instrument before reading either half.

QUESTION_1_DOES_THE_COMMITTED_REFUSAL_ST.ordering_is_semantic: the gate state is read and recorded before the paired delta is looked at, because a delta between sub-chance predictors is what the gate exists to refuse.

QUESTION_2_HOW_BIG_IS_THE_MODEL_SIDE_LEA.statistic: the DIFFERENCE between two mean paired deltas -- (model vs markov_ecoli, left_only arm) on A-minus-C, minus the same quantity on A-intersect-C.
QUESTION_2_HOW_BIG_IS_THE_MODEL_SIDE_LEA.estimator: a TWO-SAMPLE bootstrap percentile 95% CI on that difference, B=2000, RNG seed 0. NOT an overlap test between the two arms' own CIs: two CIs can overlap while their difference is resolvably non-zero, and can both span zero while the difference does not.
QUESTION_2_HOW_BIG_IS_THE_MODEL_SIDE_LEA.sign_convention: positive = the model does BETTER on the ortholog-bearing arm, i.e. the model gained from the leak

margin_is_DERIVED_not_chosen.reasoning: 0.01 nats is 52% of the committed model-vs-null delta the project is trying to interpret, and 14x the measured null-side leak. A model-side leak below it cannot overturn a delta of the committed size; above it, it can. Stated as a ratio to two measured quantities so it is not a round number picked for looking reasonable.

branches.LEAK_SMALL_FILTER_OVERPRICED: the 95% CI lies ENTIRELY within +/- 0.01. The leak is too small to overturn a delta of the committed size, and the orthology filter discards 81% of the withheld set (C/A = 0.18931) to remove it.
branches.LEAK_LARGE_FILTER_LOAD_BEARING: the CI lies entirely ABOVE +0.01. The model gained materially from near-orthologs, the filter is doing real work, and the representative re-pretrain is the route the code already recorded.
branches.LEAK_INVERTED_FILTER_SELECTS_EASIER_WIND: the CI lies entirely BELOW -0.01. The orthology-free windows are EASIER for the model than the ortholog-bearing ones, which would invert the filter's entire rationale. Named because it is possible, not because it is expected.
branches.UNRESOLVED_CONTRAST_SPANS_THE_MARGIN: the CI straddles +0.01 or -0.01. FIRST-CLASS, not a failure: report the interval and n, do NOT re-grade on the point estimate, do NOT widen the margin, and do NOT enlarge n after the fact.

WHAT_NO_OUTCOME_HERE_LICENSES: A beyond-k-mer verdict. The plan is scoped to leak-size measurement and the gate state per set; a positive model delta on an admissible set is still confounded by the near-ortholog leak this very contrast is measuring, and measuring a confound does not remove it.

Retiring the representative re-pretrain. Its rationale is weakened if the refusal turns out to be an artifact, but it is declared under R6 and killing it is a USER authority decision, never a bookkeeping consequence of a cheap result.
Any claim about generation quality. This scores infilling and continuation on held-out sequence; the project's own scorer docstring already records that a model can score well here and sample badly.
Any claim about set A being confound-free. Withholding is by SEQUENCE, so a 95%-identical ortholog in the draft E. coli remains in training for every window of A-minus-C by construction.
honest_limits: One checkpoint, one step (6000), one organism pair, one window length. Nothing here is a claim about the architecture.

The committed artifact records no seed or boot, so its CONFIDENCE INTERVALS are not reproducible from it; its point estimates reproduce exactly. No bootstrap count tried reproduces the committed CI, and that remains unexplained rather than explained away.

The margin of 0.01 nats is derived from two measured quantities but is still a judgement about what size of leak matters. A reader who disagrees with it can read the interval, which ships beside every verdict.

The null-side leak was measured at 0.0007 nats over ALL positions of ALL windows in each arm, while the model contrast runs on a 120-window seeded sample at 30 positions. The two are not the same estimator, and the null figure is the lower-variance one.
